Collinearity gives
\[
\overrightarrow{AB}=(a-1,1),\quad \overrightarrow{AC}=(-b-1,2).
\]
Since \(A,B,C\) are collinear,
\[
(a-1)(2)-1(-b-1)=0
\]
so
\[
2a+b=1.
\]
Then by Cauchy,
\[
\left(\frac1a+\frac2b\right)(2a+b)
\ge \left(\sqrt{\frac1a\cdot 2a}+\sqrt{\frac2b\cdot b}\right)^2
=(\sqrt2+\sqrt2)^2=8.
\]
Since \(2a+b=1\),
\[
\frac1a+\frac2b\ge 8.
\]
Equality occurs at \(b=2a\), giving \(a=\frac14,b=\frac12\).

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
